verdict.rationale: Relay documents payment approval setup, multi-step approval rules, automated approvals in bill pay, and role-based team access, which together cover designating teammates who can approve payments. The evidence consists of marketing lines and a help-article title with no detail on how approvers are assigned. Nothing shows a one-click approve-and-send flow. Missing for 10: evidence of one-click approve-and-send, detailed docs on assigning specific teammates as approvers, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a finance-lead, I can set up approval permissions so designated teammates can approve and send payments with one click

citations.quote: How to Set Up Payment Approvals in Relay
Upload bills, delegate tasks, automate approvals, and pay vendors the way they want to be paid.
Give team members and financial advisors secure, role-based banking access
